sources.title: Associates Program Operating Agreement
sources.supports: Section 5 'Identifying Yourself as an Associate': required disclosure wording 'As an Amazon Associate I earn from qualifying purchases.' must be stated clearly and prominently on the Site.

sources.title: Associates Program Policies (Participation Requirements; Commission Income Statement)
sources.supports: Participation Requirements 2(a)-(b): Special Links must use the Associates ID; the tag appears as XXXXX-## or such other format as Amazon designates; Special Links must link to Products; sub-tags may not be tied to individual end users. Section 2(b): prices and availability may be shown only where Amazon serves the link or via PA-API/Creators API. Unsuitable-site list item (g): no Amazon trademark in any 'tag' or Associates ID.

sources.title: Application Review Process (Associates help)
sources.supports: Qualified sales review (at least three within the first 180 days); robust original content, a rule of thumb of at least 10 posts; website content recent, generally within the last 60 days.

sources.title: Disclosures 101 for Social Media Influencers
sources.supports: Disclosure must be placed where it is hard to miss, with the endorsement message itself; disclosures on an About page or at the end of content are likely to be missed; use simple language such as 'ad' or 'sponsored'.

sources.title: Qualify your outbound links to Google (rel='sponsored')
sources.supports: rel="sponsored" marks advertisements or paid placements (paid links).
